evidence_level: offline, read-only artifact audit; compressed source on Beelink decompressed only to a temporary regular file that was removed
profile: test-sv08-01 image artifact only; no new physical measurement

gpt.sgdisk_verify: No GPT problems found; it reports an unusual 4096-sector gap between primary GPT metadata (LBA 1) and the primary partition entry array (LBA 4096).

receipt_guid_distinction.meaning: The private one-shot writer uses this value in verify_target() as a pre-write identity check for the destination device. It is not the disk GUID inside the raw image.
receipt_guid_distinction.conclusion: The different GUIDs have distinct roles and are expected to differ after the whole-device image write; the raw image GPT GUID is bound to raw_image_sha256 above.
receipt_guid_distinction.receipt_disk_guid_value: Omitted because it identifies the prior physical target.

method: Verified the private receipt and write-script SHA-256; checked compressed size/hash and xz decoding; streamed the 7,818,182,656-byte decompressed image to a temporary file while hashing; compared that hash with both write and direct-readback hashes; ran sgdisk -v, -p and -i 1..6; compared all six GPT PARTUUIDs and partition sizes with the receipt; calculated byte offsets from first LBA × 512.
limitations: This verifies the image file and historical receipt only. It does not establish current printer eMMC identity, a current physical readback, boot behavior, or permission to write.
The image remains marked deployable:false. The H616 builder still has an empty physical-image allowlist pending independent approval and boot/claim trust-path review.
The one-shot receipt was kept private; its SHA-256 and the minimum fields needed to bind the image are published.
